enabled.description: `true` if the Selective Forward feature is enabled.

defaultPhoneNumberToForward.description: Enter the phone number to forward calls to during this schedule.

ringReminderEnabled.description: When `true`, enables a ring reminder for such calls.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Enables forwarding for all calls to voicemail. This option is only available for internal phone numbers or extensions.

criteria.description: A list of criteria specifying conditions when selective forward feature is in effect.
